title: Core: tween interpolation fidelity — tint fades from black, and shape hints flatten curves to polylines
description: Two confirmed but low-impact fidelity bugs in packages/core/src/tween/interpolate.ts. (1) tint from black: :260-279 when fromType/toType is 'none' the missing side's tintColor defaults to {0,0,0} (:267-268) while only tintAmount ramps -> tintColor lerps black->target instead of holding the tinted side's color (amount 0.5 gives (128,0,0) instead of (255,0,0), ~63/255 error mid-tween). Fix: when one side is 'none' use the OTHER side's tintColor for both endpoints, ramp only tintAmount. (2) shape hints flatten curves: :822-845 reorderPathByAnchor rebuilds each path from endpoint vertices only as LINE segments (:835-838), dropping all quadratic control points, so enabling a shape hint on a curved morph silently facets both shapes. The comment claims 'morphshape uses line segments anyway' but DefineMorphShape2 (tag 84) emits curve records. Fix: preserve control points when reordering by anchor. Confidence: confirmed.
